source: Vinokurova N. Lexical Categories and Argument Structure: A Study with Reference to Sakha. Utrecht, 2005. (LOT Dissertation Series, no. 103)
notes: As (18a) shows, when suox is used, the adjective attaches a person marker –A6. This marker appears invariantly across all person/number combinations. It is the default person marker which, in a number of contexts, shows compatibility with all persons. Since first and second persons have their own highly specified morphemes chosen in the majority of contexts while third person does not, -A is by default used with third person and therefore for convenience we shall label it as ‘3’ throughout.
